heroDescription: Depth psychotherapy and relational counseling for individuals and couples in Los Angeles. A dedicated space to face difficult realities, integrate past experience, and cultivate lasting psychological change.
philosophyTitleLine1: Therapy is not merely about gaining tools to cope. It is about
philosophyTitleLine3: cultivating the mind to wake up to the wisdom in every experience.
philosophyDescription1: This work is for those committed to life as a journey – not just strategies to cope, but a genuine shift in how you relate to your identity, your anxiety, your relationships, and what your life means.
philosophyDescription2: What happens in this room is an open conversation about what you actually want — your wishes, your fears, the parts of yourself you haven’t been able to face yet. You leave with more than tools. You leave with choice.

aboutParagraph1: Born into a Hollywood film and television family, my early landscape was one of narratives and the complex machinery of human emotion. This background instilled in me a deep, editorial understanding of the human condition—the stories we tell ourselves and the truths we often hide.
aboutParagraph2: Before becoming a therapist, I spent over a decade living as a renunciate Buddhist monk, immersed in contemplative yogic practice and daily meditation. That practice remains the contemplative bedrock of my clinical work, bridging ancient wisdom and modern psychological science.
aboutParagraph3: As a licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, I provide a secure, empathetic environment where deep exploration can occur. My approach is highly individualized, recognizing that each person's path to healing and success is entirely their own.
service1Description: Deep, exploratory work integrating EMDR, Relational Gestalt, Relational Psychoanalysis, and mindfulness-based Buddhist psychology for adults navigating anxiety, depression, and the fragmentation of modern identity.
service2Description: Restoring intimacy and communication through the Gottman Method and attachment-informed somatic emotional processing, anchored in Relational Gestalt.
service3Description: Trauma-focused psychotherapy and EMDR for PTSD, attachment wounds, and experiences that still shape how you feel, relate, and respond.
ratesDescription1: Therapy is an investment in your long-term psychological well-being. Individual sessions are 50 minutes; couples sessions are 55 minutes, with 90-minute extended sessions available for deeper work.
ratesDescription2: Sessions booked directly through DEPTH are private pay. I provide monthly superbills you can submit for out-of-network reimbursement. Many clients with PPO plans receive meaningful reimbursement, depending on their specific benefits.
footerDescription: Accepting a limited number of new clients for long-term individual and couples therapy.
